notes:
Snapshot: mid-market SaaS providing multilingual customer service orchestration for e-commerce + travel verticals. 

Key objectives:
- Reduce average handle time (AHT) via agent-assist snippets and suggested replies in local tone.
- Auto-summarize multi-message tickets for 1-click triage.
- Real-time translation + locale-aware tone transformation (not literal).
- Tool-calling: create/update Zendesk tickets and push routing flags to regional queues.
- Survive promotional spikes (Black Friday-like bursts) with graceful degradation and deterministic fallbacks.

POC summary (2-week):
- Kickoff 2025-10-10 (integration with staging Zendesk + sample traffic ~50k messages/day).
- Mid-review 2025-10-21: baseline latency p50 ~120ms, p95 ~480ms for hosted small-gen models; quality OK for EN/ES but issues in AR/HI.
- Security QA 2025-11-05: asked for DPA + audit trail details.
- Last demo 2025-11-03 (FF-20251103-INTL-01). Recording: drive link above.

Quotes/notes from stakeholders:
- "Tone must feel local — not direct translation." — Head of CX (Priya R.).
- "If we exceed 5x baseline traffic during launches, system must degrade predictably; don’t drop context unexpectedly." — CTO (Evan M.).

Requirements detail:
- Latency/throughput targets: p50 <=150ms for agent-assist, p95 <=450-600ms (depends on model); throughput target 800 reqs/sec across EU/NA during peak.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market budget; interested in Optimize recommendations (batching/caching) to reduce unit cost.
- Model preferences: open-models preferred with Redwood-verified performance profiles; want quantization options but must validate QA on Arabic/Hindi.
- Routing/fallbacks: prefer region-aware routing + automatic fallback to cheaper family under capacity pressure; explicit requirement for consistent session affinity and KV cache across instances.
- Compliance: SOC2 required, SSO/SAML, audit logs for agent + system actions, customer-controlled KMS for encryption, EU data residency for EU customers.

Technical asks raised in POC:
- Need a demo of prefix/KV caching behavior with repeated ticket threads (show cost savings).
- Verify tool-calling reliability for concurrent updates to ticketing system (replay/at-least-once semantics).
- Show canary policy that rolls back to smaller model on SLA breach.

Open/legal items:
- DPA language around model training/data retention; legal to review (blocked).
- IP addendum for anonymized telemetry (customer wants opt-in).

Commercial notes:
- Interested_products = dedicated + private for predictable latency & EU residency; Hosted API acceptable for non-critical workflows.
- Estimated initial commit: 50k-200k ARR depending on dedicated capacity pricing and required retention SLA.

Next steps (short):
- SE deep-dive on 2025-11-18 to demo caching + tool-calling reliability (Riley lead).
- Legal to get DPA draft from Redwood by 2025-11-20.
- Run extended multilingual QA for AR/HI on quantized model (timeline: 2 weeks after legal signoff).
